claims.claim_text: Across five tested Binance perpetual markets, bid-heavy books were followed by higher prices more often than ask-heavy books; for BTC the extreme-decile hit rates were 55.52% versus 46.08%, a 9.43-point spread with a block-bootstrap 95% interval of 7.1 to 11.9 points.
claims.reason: Route only the checks needed to audit C1's disclosed evidence and inferential reach.

claims.claim_text: The most extreme 1% bid-heavy observations did not show a stronger resolved directional effect than the next four percentile points below them.
claims.reason: Route only the checks needed to audit C2's disclosed evidence and inferential reach.

claims.claim_text: These results do not establish a tradeable taker strategy: the most bid-heavy BTC decile earned only 0.35 basis points on average before fees, below the roughly 4–5 basis-point taker fee per side cited by the article.
claims.reason: Route only the checks needed to audit C3's disclosed evidence and inferential reach.
